extraction_rules.target: function containing the launcher-supplied address; Ghidra's own function name is kept unchanged
extraction_rules.instructions: every instruction of the function body in address order, as '<0xaddr>: <Ghidra listing text>'
extraction_rules.calls: callee name per call instruction in address order (duplicates kept); '<indirect>' when unresolved
extraction_rules.tail_jumps: jump instructions whose target is another function's entry outside the body, in address order
extraction_rules.imports: calls/tail_jumps whose target is an external function or a thunk to one, first-appearance order
extraction_rules.constants: scalar immediate operands, signed decimal, first-appearance order, deduplicated; memory displacements and addresses excluded
extraction_rules.stack_variables: variables in Ghidra's stack frame for the function, as analysis created them
extraction_rules.decompilation: DecompInterface default options; failures are recorded as status 'failed' or 'timeout'
